title: Responsive image art direction
learningObjectives: Explain responsive image art direction and choose appropriate document or embedded-resource metadata.

understand.concept: Art direction uses picture and source elements to select different image compositions for different media conditions. This differs from resolution switching, where srcset and sizes let the browser choose among versions of the same composition.
understand.whyItMatters: A crop that works on a wide screen may remove the subject on a narrow screen. Art direction lets the page select a composition designed for the available space.
understand.analogy: Art direction is like choosing a different photograph crop for a portrait frame rather than shrinking the same landscape image.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; metadata and embedding behaviour follow browser, HTTP, and search-engine processing rules.

explain.narrative: The browser uses the portrait crop on narrow screens and the landscape crop otherwise. Replace illustrative paths with real, permitted assets.

examples.explanation: The browser uses the portrait crop on narrow screens and the landscape crop otherwise. Replace illustrative paths with real, permitted assets.
examples.expectedOutput: A browser-rendered or document-head example demonstrating the HTML feature.

practise.guidedTask: Create a picture element with different mobile and desktop compositions. Keep the same meaningful alt text when the subject and purpose remain the same.
practise.independentTask: Prepare a document head or embed example. Check accessibility, security permissions, and whether metadata accurately describes the content.
hints: Use absolute canonical URLs when declaring a canonical target.
Never treat crawler directives as access control.
Use restrictive iframe permissions and a meaningful title.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of art direction in responsive images?
options: To select a different composition for a different context
questions.answer: To select a different composition for a different context
questions.explanation: Art direction selects a composition that better suits the layout or viewport.

questions.prompt: Which principle should guide metadata and embedding?
options: Accurate description, least privilege, and no false security assumptions
Use metadata as a substitute for authentication
Grant every embedded document all permissions
questions.answer: Accurate description, least privilege, and no false security assumptions
questions.explanation: Metadata should be accurate and embedded resources should receive only necessary capabilities.
